methodology.sampling: One point per backend temperature calculation refresh; browser polling never creates points.
methodology.deduplication: Intraday refreshes are idempotent within one Beijing-time minute.
methodology.official_close: Official close is stored as the single final endpoint for each trade date.
methodology.stale_guard: A rebuild is recorded only when its Beijing calendar date equals the market trade date.
methodology.chart_quality: Samples with missing A-share breadth remain in the audit history but are excluded from the connected trend line.
